about: Planted-error fixtures for dev/source-screen.ts (issue #3408). Public, deceased Family Tree persons and public record ARKs only, drawn from the e2e fixtures adelaida-martinez-mother, joao-sousa-death, hole-parents-negative and ogletree-children. Every host and donor was read live on 2026-10-16. Errors are planted in snapshot copies, never on the live tree.

shortfalls.latin_given_name: 0 of 2: no host in the donor pool carries a source that indexes a Latin given name.
shortfalls.relative_clash: 2 of 3: only the adelaida-martinez-mother conflation documents records naming a different mother.
